visualCharacteristics.purpose: embedded third-party content: a single YouTube/Vimeo video, a row of several videos side by side, or an external iframe tool/form (e.g. client file upload), optionally introduced by a heading and text

contentPattern.structure: optional first row(s) without a link = intro heading/text; each following row (or each cell of a row, for side-by-side videos) holds the embed URL as a link, an optional placeholder image (click to play) and optional caption text. YouTube and Vimeo get a 16:9 player; any other https URL is embedded as an iframe

usage: Career testimonial video rows, webinar recordings, and pages that embed a third-party upload or booking form.
reuseGuidance: Use for any iframe-based content. Use the dark option on dark-background sections (structural hook only; colours come from the design pass). Video cards with headings and descriptions belong in cards-video.
